$comment: Entry schema for contributes.sessionSources (process plugins only, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_session_sources.go; the CLI mirrors it in tools/mincode-cli/data_providers.go. A plugin declares at most 2 sources (contract maxEntries). action must name one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read' that is not aiCallable; the host answers both requests with that one action. Each source is a collapsed section under 'Plugin sources' in the AI Sessions page. The host calls the action only when the user expands the source (and on that source's own refresh): {source, request: 'list', scope: 'workspace'|'all', project?: {name, root? (only with workspace.read)}, locale} expects {"sessions": [{id, title?, detail?, model?, lastAt?, messageCount?}]} (<= {{limits.listResultMaxBytes}} bytes, first {{limits.sessionsMax}} kept, invalid or duplicate items dropped). Clicking a session sends {source, request: 'messages', session, locale} and expects {"messages": [{role, text, timestamp?, model?}]} (<= {{limits.messagesResultMaxBytes}} bytes, role one of {{lists.roles}}, text <= {{limits.messageTextMaxRunes}} characters, the last {{limits.messagesMax}} kept). Payload <= min(action maxPayloadBytes, {{limits.payloadMaxBytes}}) bytes, timeout {{limits.timeoutMs}} ms, {{limits.concurrentPerPlugin}} request in flight per plugin. Messages are always rendered as plain text (never Markdown or links). Plugin sessions are read only: the host offers no delete, rename or resume for them. icon is one of {{lists.icons}} (default chat); mark is the source badge, ^[A-Z0-9]{1,3}$ (default: the first two ASCII letters or digits of the title in upper case, else PL).
description: Session sources: read-only AI session lists in the Sessions page whose sessions and messages come from one of this plugin's read actions.

icon.description: Built-in icon name; empty or omitted means chat.

mark.description: Badge of up to 3 upper-case letters or digits; empty or omitted means the first two ASCII letters or digits of the title, else PL.

action.description: Id of one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read' that is not aiCallable.
